name: PT Trias Sentosa Tbk
summary: PT Trias Sentosa Tbk manufactures and trades in polypropylene and polyester films in Indonesia, Japan, rest of Asia, the United States, Australia, Europe, and Africa. The company manufactures and sells biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) films and biaxially oriented polyester (BOPET) films and plastics; and offers solutions of plastic packaging conversion products. It also provides sustainable, barrier, label, cast polypropylene, and paper lamination films. In addition, the company manufactures and sells plastic products; and involved in investment, trading, import, export, distribution, and other activities.
